transcript: On my way home, I was walking through the town Though I was tired, my steps felt light Passing through a narrow alley and crossing a small plaza I felt the atmosphere of the town The street lamps cast gentle shadows and I walked on Leaving the butcher shop behind I saw the bakery sign glowing, a rich scent drifted out, and my mood began to improve Near home, I happened upon an old friend, seeing me he waved and laughed The encounter was an unexpected joy, exchanging a few words with him I felt the day's tiredness vanish completely Walking through the town I felt the small delights of daily life Quietly embrace me

segments.text: On my way home, I was walking through the town
Though I was tired, my steps felt light
Passing through a narrow alley and crossing a small plaza
I felt the atmosphere of the town
The street lamps cast gentle shadows and I walked on
I saw the bakery sign glowing, a rich scent drifted out, and my mood began to improve
Near home, I happened upon an old friend, seeing me he waved and laughed
The encounter was an unexpected joy, exchanging a few words with him
I felt the day's tiredness vanish completely
I felt the small delights of daily life
